summary.text: Kevin B. Hornberger, a Republican, represents District 35B (Cecil County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hornberger was born in North East, Maryland, on June 26, 1981, and graduated from Rising Sun High School in 1999.
The legislature's biography lists an associate degree in general studies from Cecil College in 2002 and a B.S. in mechanical engineering from the University of the District of Columbia in 2010.
It lists Hornberger as president and owner of Blue Collar Engineer, Inc. since 2006 and as a facility manager at the Library of Congress from 2006 to 2023, and notes that Hornberger has two children.
